matched_feedback.scope: Exploratory three-project full-target comparison, one model and two repeated requests. Equal output cap/repair opportunities/public tests, not equal realized compute. Free denominator is 6; same-library denominators are 12. Original libraries saw all public requirements. No novel-source transfer, pure feedback causal estimate, browser-tool agent, or library upper bound.

matched_feedback_frontier.scope: Exploratory GPT-5 medium replication with one request chain per condition, no transmitted seed or temperature. Same public feedback and per-response cap; actual computation differs. Three no-library and six candidates per same-library method. Separate from the two-repeat GPT-OSS cohort; no pure reasoning/model effect or broad generalization claim.

compiler_reuse_audit.scope: Posthoc execution-path audit, no new model or browser scores. Exact reuse requires unchanged compiler input files, schema-valid data, complete output matching a captured compiler return and the original saved source. Files-form runtime reuse remains unclassified; no full-library upper bound or causal claim.

bom_task20_posthoc_sensitivity.scope: Exclude the newly identified weak current-file test from every original main method. Stored scores unchanged; this does not correct or certify all remaining assertions.

calibration_exception.reason: Missing content iframe is null, satisfies toBeDefined, and returns before feature assertions.

schema_search.scope: Five libraries; deterministic bounded single-change search around three anchors, including non-Boolean values, optional omission/insertion and arrays. Task-20 current and complete-history endpoints only. BOM current-file passes include a known vacuous-test risk and are not feature-correctness witnesses alone. No uniform full-schema sampling or impossibility bound. Original 53/120 and 14/120 witness snapshots unchanged.

costs.scope: New calls in this authorization only. Earlier unresolved reservations remain in their original closed ledgers. Abandoned protocol-development calls are included. Local compute and human time are unpriced.
